channel.title: Congress Report Card weekly digest
channel.description: Missed votes, grade changes and bills that became law, every Saturday.

item.title: Week ending November 7, 2026
item.description:
Here is what changed in the public record of Congress from October 31 to November 7, 2026.

Votes this week

Neither chamber held a roll-call vote this week.

Bills that became law

  • HR 8205: Accelerating Access to Critical Therapies for ALS Reauthorization Act of 2026. Sponsored by Mike Quigley (D, IL-5).
  • HR 1744: United States Commission on International Religious Freedom Reauthorization Act of 2026. Sponsored by Christopher H. Smith (R, NJ-4).

Grade changes

11 members moved to a different letter grade. Bill scores are ranked within each chamber, so a grade can move when other members' records change.

Biggest gains

  • Robert F. Onder, Jr. (R, MO-3): C to C+
  • Mike Quigley (D, IL-5): C- to C
  • Kathy Castor (D, FL-14): B- to B
  • Ed Case (D, HI-1): B to B+

Biggest drops

  • Thomas Massie (R, KY-4): D to D-
  • Mike Flood (R, NE-1): B to B-
  • Joseph D. Morelle (D, NY-25): B to B-
  • Nanette Diaz Barragán (D, CA-44): B- to C+
  • Bryan Steil (R, WI-1): B to B-

See every member's grade at congressreportcard.org, or read how grades are calculated.
